_readme: Research data: each booking partner's own page for hotels in each Ujjain area. NOT used by the website yet — nothing reads this file, and every partner stays switched off in data/affiliates.json. Store only partner page links and short page titles; never hotel names, prices, ratings or distances. Evidence: 'opened' = we loaded the page and its title matches; 'exists' = the page loads (partner sends unknown addresses to its 404 page) but its content needs JavaScript; 'search' = found in web/Google search with a matching title, but the partner blocks automated checks, so the owner must test it on a phone; 'openseo' = seen in an OpenSEO Google results check (India, 22 Nov 2026). Report: docs/AFFILIATE-LINKS.md

cuelinks.status: Owner joined (22 Nov 2026). Campaign approval and link format still to confirm in the dashboard.
cuelinks.subIds: Up to 5 sub-ID parameters per tracking link (stated on each Cuelinks campaign page).

makemytrip.name: MakeMyTrip (Hotels)
makemytrip.payoutShown: Upto ₹135 per sale (category rates visible after login)
makemytrip.media: Allowed: text link, banner, social media, coupons. Disallowed: Facebook ads, search ads (SEM), native/pop ads, HTML email.
makemytrip.notes: Countries: India. Payout for new and repeat users. No minimum booking value stated on the campaign page.

goibibo.name: Goibibo (Hotels)
goibibo.payoutShown: Upto ₹252 per sale (category rates visible after login)
goibibo.media: Allowed: text link, banner, coupons. Disallowed: social media, Facebook ads, search ads (SEM), deals, native/pop ads, HTML email.
goibibo.notes: Brand bidding / PPC / Meta ads strictly prohibited. Only Cuelinks-supplied or site-listed coupons are paid.

agoda.name: Agoda
agoda.media: Conflicting on the page: the media list allows text links, but 'Important information' says 'Text Link - Forbidden'. Banners and social media allowed; cashback forbidden.
agoda.notes: Agoda's own direct programme (partners.agoda.com) is separate; its deep-link support is unconfirmed.
